blocks.sub: Synthesis for the strategist. Full evidence trail lives in the detective report; this is the compressed, table-forward view.

blocks.text: The detective found the scheduler itself sound — the failure is entirely at the consumer boundary, where two independent readers make the same wrong assumption about what job presence proves.

blocks.body: "A cron job proves a durable heartbeat" is assumed by two consumers and true for neither. The gate and the handoff writer both read job PRESENCE as proof of job PERSISTENCE.

blocks.label: Lane verdict
blocks.text: The scheduler itself is sound and well-documented. The failure is entirely at the consumer boundary: nothing downstream distinguishes 'never armed' from 'armed and silently expired.'

cards.title: loop-gate false-pass
cards.body: Gate re-passes on an expired job because absence-of-error is read as presence-of-heartbeat.

cards.title: Docs say durable
cards.body: Onboarding copy says 'schedule your own wakeups' with no caveat about the 7-day cap.

cards.title: 9,39 off-herd convention
cards.body: Every citizen sampled honors it; nowhere is it enforced or linted.

rows.v: Track durability outside the session table, or just add a distinguishable expired-vs-never-armed gate state?
handoff-writer shares this exact false-pass risk — worth a joint fix, not two patches
